items.text: Leave by taxi. Ask for Shijō-mae Station (市場前駅).
Auction ~5:45–6:25, watch the floor until ~7:00, browse open shops. Light snack only.
Meet 8:25 at the Starbucks in front of Tsukiji Station. Eat on the tour; bring cash.
Matcha and a sweet at Nakajima no Ochaya.
Ishikawa shop (ask for the Agehama salt) and Itoya.
Dimitar only. Fujijapan sign at 1-9-8 Nishiasakusa; all tools provided.

items.label: Kappabashi again
items.text: Most shops close 17:00–17:30. Or walk Asakusa.

REMINDER: if APA can't send the suitcases, hand them in at Asakusa Post Office (Nishi-Asakusa 1-1-1, next to the hotel; open until 19:00), Yu-Pack to HOTEL TAVINOS, delivery Sat 14. Keep an overnight bag for Fri 13. Ask if suitcases sent to Haneda later can wait at the airport until Mon 23.
Taxi to Ryōgoku, or train: Toei Asakusa Line Asakusa → Kuramae, then Ōedo Line → Ryōgoku.
First choice Chanko Kawasaki (Ryōgoku 2-13-1), cash only, no booking. Look around if full.
Back to the hotel: Ōedo Line → Kuramae, Toei Asakusa Line → Asakusa, walk ~10 min. Or taxi.
